criteria.criterion: Existing public hooks and structured sinks correlate logical request, distinct retry/redirect attempts, physical reused connection and actual H2 stream IDs.
criteria.note: Pool-hook-only native redirect also passes without a caller event sink; the existing hook adapter installs the sink before attempt creation.

criteria.criterion: Actual stage boundaries and effective deadline owners integrate M10-001 without inventing reasons for unexpired native TimedOut.
M10-002 snapshots use real resource leases, admission rejection and reclamation completion, rather than request-facade counters.
criteria.note: H2 cancellation completion follows channel/request/stream/exchange cleanup; pending cancellation is not reported complete.

criteria.criterion: M10-003 actual H1/H2 pools, held bodies and transferred sessions expose bounded current owners and clean up at shutdown.
M10-004 direct/proxy resolver and TLS generations remain observable during live leases, graceful drain and security replacement.
criteria.note: Snapshots retain the current plus bounded retained owners. Snapshot sampling neither rotates nor collects generations.

criteria.criterion: Native resolver workers, queued queries and cache entries come from actual owners; unavailable custom owners remain unknown and post-close samples remain historical.
criteria.note: Three delayed getaddrinfo cases explicitly skip without the 500 ms fixture; both SDK fixture runs actually execute all five selected cases.

criteria.criterion: Callbacks are outside owner locks; throwing and reentrant hook/sink/exporter callbacks do not change IO results or create unbounded workers.
Optional adapter has fixed queue bounds, deterministic sampling, honest drops, batching and finite flush/close without high-cardinality aggregation or global services.
criteria.note: One export worker plus at most one lazily created cancellation dispatcher. A noncooperative callback can outlive close; close returns false rather than reporting termination.

criteria.criterion: Structured payload and default diagnostic output do not expose credentials, cookies, query/body data, certificate secrets or arbitrary exception messages.
criteria.note: Installed runner checks original stdout/stderr for secret markers before redaction; loopback native fixtures and bounded snapshots are exercised, not source-only assertions.

criteria.criterion: Real disabled/enabled workload, raw samples, installed consumer and native FD/task rollback are recorded without release, SLA or unsupported-platform claims.
criteria.note: Fresh archive extraction and manifest verification outside checkout for each installed run. RSS recorded, not used as an exact-zero allocator assertion.
